## Purpose

Describe the problem or requirement and the previous verified state.

## Material changes

Describe code, configuration, documentation, or architecture changed by this pull request.

## Validation

List the exact tests/checks run and their observed results.

## Security and privacy

Describe security/privacy implications, including whether privileged networking, secrets, telemetry, packet data, or personal data are affected.

## Recovery and rollback

Describe how the change can be reverted or recovered safely.

## Release boundary

State whether this is source development only, release-candidate work, or an accepted release. Do not equate merge with production acceptance.
